slides.title: Your fall decor is in 4 different closets. Try one bin per season.
slides.sub: Found the pumpkins in March again?

slides.title: One bin per season
slides.body: Fall gets one bin. Holidays get one bin. If it doesn't fit, you have a choice, not a storage problem.

slides.title: Pick a clear bin
slides.body: See the orange through the side and you know it's fall. No opening four lids to check.

slides.title: Swap, don't add
slides.body: When fall decor comes out, the summer stuff goes in that same bin. Shelf space stays the same.

slides.title: Tape a photo on top
slides.body: Snap the shelf or mantel when it looks good. Next year, copy the photo. No decisions.

slides.title: I don't need more decor. I need to find the decor I already own.
Want the whole-home reset?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
